name: Shuuen Ouse
source: High school students Nanoi and Honose were having a relaxing time at a cafe, chatting peacefully. However, the world, shrouded in a curse-like unrest, is steadily heading towards its end. What will be the fate of the two people left behind?
translation: 高中生奈井和穗濑在咖啡店里悠闲地聊天。然而，这个世界笼罩在诅咒般的动荡之中，正在稳步走向末日。留下的两个人的命运将会如何？
